candidates.claim: The effective OT_IN permit at position 4 lets OT hosts open tcp/443 to any destination, including the Internet, which is not an approved cross-zone service.
candidates.remediation: Remove the OT_IN permit for tcp/443 to 0.0.0.0/0 or restrict it to the approved services.

candidates.claim: The effective DMZ_IN permit at position 0 lets jump host 10.10.20.30 send any IP traffic to the OT subnet, beyond the approved tcp/3389 access to engineering workstation 10.10.10.40.
candidates.remediation: Restrict the DMZ_IN entry for the jump host to tcp/3389 toward 10.10.10.40 only.

candidates.claim: sw-core-01 has a read-write SNMP community with no ACL restriction, which violates the read-only and MGMT-restricted SNMP policy.
candidates.remediation: Remove the read-write community and keep only a read-only community restricted by the MGMT-only ACL.

candidates.claim: sw-ot-01 is configured to send logs to 192.168.30.77, which is outside the MGMT zone where logging destinations must be.
candidates.remediation: Remove the 192.168.30.77 logging host from sw-ot-01 and use the MGMT syslog server 10.10.99.60.

candidates.claim: The DMZ_IN access-list entry for the jump host to OT (access-list DMZ_IN) is present in the current snapshot but not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile against the approved baseline: revert the entry or approve it as a documented change.

candidates.claim: The OT_IN access-list entry permitting OT tcp/443 to any destination (access-list OT_IN) is present in the current snapshot but not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile against the approved baseline: revert the entry or approve it as a documented change.

candidates.claim: The SNMP community entry on sw-core-01 is present in the current snapshot but not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile against the approved baseline: remove the community or approve it as a documented change.

candidates.claim: The logging host 192.168.30.77 on sw-ot-01 is present in the current snapshot but not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile against the approved baseline: remove the logging host or approve it as a documented change.
